description: Your resume should never be out of date again. Diverge connects your AI assistant to your professional profile, so you update it, tailor it to any job, and download a polished PDF just by chatting. Keep multiple personas for different roles, and see how your shared resume performs. No forms, no copy-paste. Just tell your assistant, and it's done.
